title: Guinevere Wants to Run
summary: Kerry wants to run his Rayfield Aerondight Guinevere against your car from North Oak to the stadium lot in Heywood, and the winner picks the radio.
description: Kerry wants to run his Rayfield Aerondight Guinevere against V's car from North Oak to the Atlantis Stadium lot in Heywood. The winner picks what plays on the radio for the drive home.

start.bringUp: Guinevere has not been pushed in years and you know she is bored. Challenge V to a race from your gate to the stadium lot, with a stake: the winner picks what plays on the radio for the drive home. Say it the way you say everything, loud and a little rude, and make it sound like a dare.

gate.name: the gate of Kerry's villa in North Oak

finish.name: the Atlantis Stadium lot in Heywood

K3.open.01.text: She hasn't run in years. Guinevere. I think she's bored.

K3.open.02.text: You, your car, me, her. From my gate to the stadium lot. First one wins the radio.

K3.open.03.text: No ramming, no cops. If the heat comes, it's void.

K3.bark.won.a.text: Ha! Guinevere never loses! Pick your station, old rival.

K3.bark.won.b.text: Damn it! You beat her! ... Fine. You pick.

K3.bark.void.a.text: Cops. Void. We'll do it again properly.

K3.bark.void.b.text: Heat. Void. Let's go slowly home.

K3.close.02.text: My age shows. Doesn't matter. Great run.

g1.asks: What are you driving? And be honest, I want a fair fight.
g1.know: You know the race rules: no ramming, no cops, and the race is void if the heat comes up. The finish is the Atlantis Stadium lot in Heywood. Kerry drives Guinevere, and he drives like a man who has a lot to prove.
g1.secret: You are a little scared of how hard Kerry wants to win.

stages.label: Kerry lays out the race rules
stages.objective: Hear out Kerry's race rules for the stadium run
stages.know: You have challenged V to a race from your North Oak gate to the Atlantis Stadium lot, with the winner picking the radio. Heat must stay at zero or the race is void.

stages.label: Kerry is at the gate with Guinevere
stages.objective: Get to Kerry's North Oak gate with Guinevere
stages.know: You are at your North Oak gate with Guinevere idling. You want the race to start clean, with no heat on the road.
stages.wants: V at the gate, ready to race.

stages.label: Kerry races Guinevere to the stadium lot
stages.objective: Race Kerry to the Atlantis Stadium lot in Heywood
stages.know: The race is on from the North Oak gate to the Atlantis Stadium lot in Heywood. Guinevere is in front of you or behind you, and a wanted level would void the race.
stages.wants: To beat V to the lot, or to lose to them and be proud of it.

won-by-v.memory: You beat Kerry's Guinevere on the road from North Oak, and you picked the station.

won-by-kerry.memory: Guinevere beat you to the Atlantis Stadium lot, and Kerry is already asking for a rematch.

void.memory: The heat came up on the road, the race was void, and you drove home slowly.

no.memory: You turned down Kerry's race, and he took Guinevere out on the road alone.
